name: connectwise
description: ConnectWise Manage API connector for ticket operations
_setup_notes: CW_CLIENT_ID: shared client ID — same for all engineers (ffaf1132-9e1e-4b20-894c-9741dcd0c290)
CW_PUBLIC_KEY and CW_PRIVATE_KEY: each engineer must generate their OWN API keys under CW Account Settings -> API Keys.
Do NOT share keys — API keys authenticate as the user who created them. Using someone else's keys means actions are logged under their account and their ticket permissions apply.
